title: Refuse-if-token-missing guard on elicited surfaces: a submit without a token is rejected with 400 before any downstream logic
description: The applying project registers a token-required guard at every elicited surface. A submit whose payload lacks the Cf-Turnstile-Response field is rejected with 400 before any downstream handler runs. The refusal body carries a stable error-code (turnstile.token-missing), not the sitekey.
rationale: Ratified in the Cloudflare round 6 spec (2026-09-06 section 5.5). Ships as v1.0.0 of edge-cloudflare-turnstile.
